name: redreplier
description: Find the conversations on Reddit, X, Hacker News, Bluesky and Facebook that mention your brand or the keywords you care about. Add your websites and keywords, and RedReplier collects matching mentions, scores how relevant each one is and explains the score. Ask for a suggested reply, approve or reject mentions, and set up email alerts. RedReplier never posts anything to those networks.

interface.longDescription: Find the conversations on Reddit, X, Hacker News, Bluesky and Facebook that mention your brand or the keywords you care about. Add your websites and keywords, and RedReplier collects matching mentions, scores how relevant each one is and explains the score. Ask for a suggested reply, approve or reject mentions, and set up email alerts. RedReplier never posts anything to those networks.
defaultPrompt: List the websites and keywords I monitor
Suggest a reply to my top mention

positive.description: List monitored websites and their keywords.
positive.prompt: Which websites am I monitoring on RedReplier, and which keywords are active?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each monitored website with its keywords and each keyword's status. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: List workspaces and the websites in each.
positive.prompt: List my RedReplier workspaces and the websites I monitor in each.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspaces this sign-in can reach, then the monitored websites in each, such as flowsery.com, redreplier.com and adaptlypost.com in the AdaptlyPost workspace.

positive.description: Show the most relevant Reddit mentions from last month.
positive.prompt: Show me the most relevant Reddit mentions from last month, skipping the ones I rejected.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns last month's Reddit posts and comments ranked by relevance, with their scores and links, and leaves out rejected mentions. Says so if there are none.

positive.prompt: How many mentions scoring 50 or higher did I get last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports how many of last month's mentions scored 50 or higher, including when the answer is zero.

positive.description: Explain why a mention got its score.
positive.prompt: Find my highest-scoring mention from last month and explain why it scored that high.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds last month's top-scoring mention and explains its score. An explanation that doesn't exist yet is generated and saved. No reply is posted. If there are no mentions, says so.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general Reddit browsing.
negative.prompt: What are the top posts on r/startups today?

negative.description: Do not trigger for the user's own Reddit account stats.
negative.prompt: How much karma does my Reddit account have?

negative.description: Do not trigger for posting to Reddit.
negative.prompt: Write and post a thread in r/SaaS announcing our launch.

review.commerce_description: RedReplier does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes:
Initial release. Find the conversations on Reddit, X, Hacker News, Bluesky and Facebook that mention your brand or the keywords you care about.

- Add your websites and keywords, and RedReplier collects matching mentions, including posts in Facebook pages and groups.
- See how relevant each mention is and why it got that score.
- Ask for a suggested reply, and approve or reject mentions.
- Set up email alerts for new mentions.
- Work in any RedReplier workspace you belong to.

RedReplier never posts anything to those networks.
